task: Classify immune class in endometrial carcinoma. Classes: low, medium, and high immune infiltration. On H&E, the key distinction is the amount and distribution of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, stromal immune cells, and inflammatory reaction around and within tumor glands.

classes.0: Low immune class with sparse tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and minimal stromal inflammatory infiltrate.
classes.1: Medium immune class with a moderate, patchy lymphocytic infiltrate in tumor and stroma.
classes.2: High immune class with dense diffuse tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and prominent stromal inflammation.
